description: This PHP script handles importing iCalendar (.ics) files into the Calendar module of a CRM system, including uploading files, processing calendar events and todos, saving records, and undoing last imports.

classes.name: iCalLastImport
classes.description: Class managing the last import record for calendar data.

classes.name: iCalendar_event
classes.description: Class representing a calendar event for import.

classes.name: iCalendar_todo
classes.description: Class representing a calendar todo item for import.

methods.name: clearRecords
methods.description: Clears previous import records for a user.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets fields for the last import record.

methods.name: generateArray
methods.description: Generates an array of calendar data from iCal activity.

methods.name: activity_reminder
methods.description: Sets a reminder for a calendar activity.
